creative_brief.title: The Quantum Core
creative_brief.art_direction_mandate: Strict Full-Color Production Art Direction Addendum. ZERO default grey materials. Saturation >= 0.15 on >= 25% pixels.

character_design.name: Nova

palette.eyes: Dual-tone sclera with luminous cyan pupil
palette.boots_gloves: Navy with silver guards and cyan sole runners

character_design.rigging: Full skeletal armature with Root, Spine, Chest, Neck, Head, 2-bone IK arms (Hand_IK) and legs (Foot_IK)

prop_design.name: Quantum Core

palette.gimbal_rings: Inner Titanium-Cyan, Outer Polished Silver Chrome
palette.emitter_struts: Silver pylons with Green (#00E676) and Amber (#FFAB00) LED arrays

prop_design.dynamics: Multi-axis gyroscopic rotation, kinetic surge response, scale pulsation, harmonic stabilization

palette.floor: #141A24 (Dark Metallic Carbon Tiles with controlled specular reflections)
palette.walls_consoles: Charcoal navy monoliths with glowing cyan telemetry screens
palette.lighting: 3-point sci-fi setup (Key: 750W Cool Cyan, Fill: 400W Deep Blue, Rim: 900W Warm Amber)

shot_breakdown.name: Wide Intro / Establishing
shot_breakdown.camera: Wide high tracking pan from (0, -8.5, 2.8) to (0, -6.8, 2.2)
shot_breakdown.narrative_action: Nova enters forgotten subterranean facility, walking toward glowing Quantum Core pedestal. Foot IK stride animation with dynamic mantle flow.
shot_breakdown.audio: DL_01 (Narrator: 'Deep within the forgotten facility...') + SFX_01 (Reactor Hum) + SFX_02 (Footsteps)

shot_breakdown.name: Medium Approach & Inspection
shot_breakdown.narrative_action: Nova arrives at core pedestal, stops, tilts head upward inspecting containment field. Alert frown expression and natural blinking.
shot_breakdown.audio: DL_02 (Nova: 'Readings confirmed. Magnetic confinement is holding steady.') + SFX_01 + SFX_03 (Interface Chime)

shot_breakdown.name: Close-Up Core Interaction & Arm Reach
shot_breakdown.camera: Close-up profile at (-0.95, -1.45, 1.42) focused on Core and Nova's arm
shot_breakdown.narrative_action: Nova extends right hand (Hand_IK.R) toward outer gimbal ring. Core crystal reacts with harmonic scale pulse and accelerated gyroscopic spin.
shot_breakdown.audio: DL_03 (Nova: 'Initiating physical kinetic transfer test.') + SFX_03 + SFX_04 (Energy Surge)

shot_breakdown.name: OTS Surge Event & Defensive Brace
shot_breakdown.camera: Over-The-Shoulder at (0.42, -2.35, 1.58) with high-frequency micro-jitter during shockwave
shot_breakdown.narrative_action: Violent kinetic surge! Core flashes cyan and violet corona expands. Nova recoils backward, snapping left arm across chest in defensive brace.
shot_breakdown.audio: DL_04 (Nova: 'Release phase active. Vector locked.') + SFX_04 + SFX_05 (Barrier Lock)

shot_breakdown.name: Secondary Console Calibration & Stabilization
shot_breakdown.camera: Medium profile at (-2.7, -1.7, 1.72) capturing Nova and calibration console
shot_breakdown.narrative_action: Nova rapidly executes emergency calibration at secondary console. Emitter strut LEDs switch Amber to Green. Core gyroscopic spin decelerates into steady harmonic lock.
shot_breakdown.audio: DL_05 (Narrator: 'The deflector absorbed the impact. The containment ring sealed instantly.') + SFX_05 + SFX_06 (Harmonic Outro)

shot_breakdown.name: Wide Hero Climax & Resolution
shot_breakdown.camera: Hero dolly backward from (0, -3.2, 1.55) to wide (0, -7.2, 2.50) looking upward
shot_breakdown.narrative_action: Nova in resolute hero stance, hands relaxed at sides, smiling with confidence. Vast subterranean laboratory illuminated in cyan and navy with humming Quantum Core.
shot_breakdown.audio: DL_06 (Nova: 'The expedition lives to see tomorrow.') + SFX_06 + Master BGM crescendo

verification_strategy.color_qa_gate: Each shot must achieve >= 25.0% saturated pixels (HSV saturation >= 0.15) with confirmed clusters for cyan, navy, skin tone, and silver.
verification_strategy.geometry_qa_gate: Zero primitive grey geometry. All 48 meshes bound to specific production materials.
verification_strategy.timeline_gate: Exact 1,440 frames @ 24 fps = 60.00 seconds master video.
verification_strategy.audio_gate: 100% synchronized dialogue, procedural SFX, ambient score, and burned subtitles.
